messages:
Sasha (ops): incident-bot paging: GPU pool 'us-west-2-gpu-pool-3' at 95% utilization, request queue length spiking to 1800 -> triggering throttles. Seen since 17:12 UTC.

incident-bot: ALERT: autoscaler failed to increase pool size for pool id gpu-pool-3. Error: 'scale limit reached for tenant redwood-dedicated-usw2'

Jordan (oncall): I'm taking this. Confirming customer-facing routes impacted? Any 5xx increase? @Alyssa can you check major tenants?

Alyssa (customer-success): Getting reports from Customer X and Y experiencing increased latencies and some timeouts on long-context chat sessions. They're seeing API 429/504 for a subset. I'm flagging top 3 accounts, pushing a heads-up to CS channel.

Sasha (ops): metrics snapshot:
- total queued requests (1m): 1789
- avg latency tail (p95 gen): 1.8s -> 4.2s
- token throughput per GPU: down 28% (context blowup)
- kv-cache memory per worker: +65% over baseline

Matt (eng-runtime): Observed increased per-request KV cache population on model v17.2 rollout. Context lengths trending from median 1024 -> 4096 for some traffic shards; KV cache warmup amplifies memory usage and increases per-token compute. We rolled v17.2 to 40% yesterday.

Lee (sre): Autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts hit tenant quota and node group max-size. Manual scale blocked by policy. Screenshot from autoscaler: 
```
2026-03-15T17:08:12Z INFO scaleAttempt tenant=redwood-dedicated-usw2 desired=24 current=16 reason=queue_spike
2026-03-15T17:08:13Z ERROR scaleFailed reason=quotaExceeded limit=24
```

Jordan (oncall): Okay we have two coupled failures: model rollout increased resource per-request -> queue growth -> autoscaler can't grow due to quota -> throttling. Immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback v17.2 traffic split 2) open manual override to increase node group temporarily 3) tighten request-level safeguards (reject long-context > 2048) 4) prioritize critical customers via routing policy. Which do we do now?

Matt (eng-runtime): Recommend rollback for the rollout shard (traffic tag v17-canary) to v16.8 in the next 5–10min. That will reduce KV cache blowup and free memory. Also we should patch the runtime to pre-emptively cap KV prefill to mitigate warmup pressure, but that's medium-term.

Sasha (ops): Rolling back canary now. Triggering via deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: /deploy rollback model=v17.2 target=canary shard=42 reason='kv-cache/memory surge causing autoscale failure'

deploy-bot: rollback started. ETA ~ 3m.

Jordan (oncall): While rollback runs, I'll open a ticket with infra to raise the temporary quota for redwood-dedicated-usw2 by +6 nodes to allow autoscaler breathing room if rollback doesn't reduce queue fast enough. @Lee can you escalate?

Lee (sre): Escalating to infra quota on-call and cloud provider support. Also adding a temporary RBAC override for manual scale for oncall.

Alyssa (customer-success): Pushed status update to impacted customers: "We are actively mitigating a capacity issue impacting long-context requests; rolling back a recent model rollout and applying temporary capacity adjustments. We'll update within 30 minutes."

Matt (eng-runtime): Post-rollback signals: KV memory per worker trending down (~30% within first minute) but queue still at 1200. That matches expectation: some in-flight long-context sessions will finish and free memory slowly.

Sasha (ops): Autoscaler started new scale attempts at 17:22:xx and succeeded to allocate +2 nodes (manual override allowed). New pool size 18 -> 20. Queue down to 620. Throttles still applied to low-priority traffic.

Jordan (oncall): Applying emergency routing policy: prioritization for enterprise tenants, low-priority traffic capped at 10rps. Command posted to ops-control: 
```
ops-control set-priority-rules pool=gpu-pool-3 priority=enterprise cap=unlimited other=10rps
```

Lee (sre): Cloud provider increased quota by +4 nodes after support call; infra team scheduling full group scale to 24 but flagged pending approvals.

Matt (eng-runtime): We need a follow-up: example mitigation per request: if context length > 2048 and tenant != enterprise then return a 413-like response (or soft truncate) to avoid KV prefill. Also add a flag to model rollout jobs to throttle initial concurrency when context growth is detected.

Sasha (ops): Current status 17:35 UTC: queue length 180, p95 gen back to 1.4s, GPU util 72%. Rolling window shows customer error rates decreasing.

Alyssa (customer-success): Customers confirm recovery for most flows. Customer X still seeing occasional tail errors; CS is coordinating a follow-up with engineering for a postmortem.

Jordan (oncall): Incident classification: Sev-2. Actions taken: rollback v17.2 canary, manual temporary scale override, apply prioritization throttle, open cloud quota escalation, customer comms. Postmortem owner: Matt (eng-runtime).

Matt (eng-runtime): I'll own the postmortem. Initial RCA hypothesis: change in v17.2 increased KV cache prefill and per-request memory due to a change in attention window handling for long contexts -> effective per-request GPU cost increased ~2.8x for long sessions. We'll include telemetry gaps and rollout gating failures in the doc.

Lee (sre): Recommended action items (short):
- Add rollout preflight perf test measuring per-request memory stat with synthetic long-context workload.
- Add hard limit on autoscaler scale attempts per tenant and fallback policy to shift traffic to alternate region when limit hit.
- Add request-level context-length guardrails on the gateway.
- Improve canary traffic isolation and reduce initial traffic share to 10% for risky model changes.

Sasha (ops): Adding interim runbook note: when kv-cache memory jumps >40% post-deploy, immediately rollback and open manual scale override until rollback stabilizes.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: GPU pool 'us-west-2-gpu-pool-3' mitigated. Incident state -> RESOLVED (post-rollback stabilization).

Jordan (oncall): Wrapping up: Matt please include timeline, metrics, config diffs, and exact query traces for the postmortem. I'll schedule a 1-hour incident review with SRE/Runtime/Infra/CS tomorrow.

Alyssa (customer-success): I'll coordinate customer brief and follow-up RACI.

Matt (eng-runtime): Will file postmortem ticket and link in this thread. Thanks everyone for quick responses.

Sasha (ops): thumbs up :thumbsup: reopening only if regressions appear in next 48h.

deploy-bot: action-log: rollback completed at 17:19:41 UTC; rollback id=rb-20260315-1720

Jordan (oncall): last check 17:42 UTC: all metrics within normal range. I'll hand back to oncall rotation.

Sasha (ops): oncall handoff: Jordan -> Sasha (next shift) at 18:00 UTC.

end of thread
